title: OpenShard receipt sync envelope v1
description: Privacy-bounded machine receipt sent from OpenShard Core to the Platform. See docs/architecture/receipt-sync-contract.md.

receipt_schema_version.description: Core runs.jsonl record schema version (1.0, 1.1, 1.2, unknown) when Core reports it.

receipt_id.description: Globally unique receipt identity minted by Core at record creation. Hosted idempotency key.

shard_id.description: Core history-position label (shard-YYYYMMDD-NNNN). Not globally unique; compatibility only.

anyOf.description: Engineering-task identity minted by Core. Explicit (openshard task new) unless task_grouping says Core grouped it from the session. Stored as sent; never inferred.

task_grouping.description: How Core arrived at task_id: explicit (declared), session (grouped from the observed session) or branch. Absent: explicit.

created_at.description: Record creation time, ISO-8601 with zone.

depth.description: How much Core could ever observe of this run.

status.description: Whether evidence is known to be lost.

integrity.description: Core content-hash verdict for the stored record (tamper evidence only, never a signature).

task_short.description: May be a prompt-derived excerpt in hook-captured sessions.

task_full.description: May be a prompt-derived excerpt in hook-captured sessions.

task_title.description: Concise display title derived by Core from the task. Display metadata only; task_short/task_full stay the recorded task.

attribution.description: agent_reported | git_observed | pre_existing | other_session; null for records that predate attribution.

diff_added.description: Lines added to this file (Core lines_added). Null or absent is unknown, never 0.

diff_removed.description: Lines removed from this file (Core lines_removed). Null or absent is unknown, never 0.

binary.description: Whether git reported this file as binary (no line counts). Null or absent is unknown.

attribution.description: agent_reported | git_observed | pre_existing | other_session; null for records that predate attribution.

diff_added.description: Lines added to this file (Core lines_added). Null or absent is unknown, never 0.

diff_removed.description: Lines removed from this file (Core lines_removed). Null or absent is unknown, never 0.

binary.description: Whether git reported this file as binary (no line counts). Null or absent is unknown.

verification.description: Core structured verification evidence (block v1). Preferred over checks/status/verification_status when present.

name.description: Short, secret-scrubbed check name. Never argv or output.

setup_failed.description: OpenShard could not set the project up to run this check. The check's own status stays unknown.

reported_runner.description: With setup_failed: the runner whose own summary line the counts come from. Never its output.

output_sha256.description: sha256 of everything the check printed (stdout and stderr). Never the output itself.

output_bytes.description: Size in bytes of the output output_sha256 covers.

owner.description: Run owner recorded by Core. Null when Core did not record one. Never derived from organisation presentation metadata.

repo.description: Core repo_name: the local repository folder name (or workspace folder). Not a URL, not host/owner/repo, never a path.

repo_identity.description: Core repo_identity: canonical host/owner/repo derived from the git origin remote (credentials, .git suffix and local-path remotes stripped by Core). Null when the checkout has no hosted remote. Never a path.

tokens_not_recorded_reason.description: Why tokens are absent, e.g. workspace_usage_attributed_to_other_repository when another Receipt of the same session holds them.

cost_not_recorded_reason.description: Why cost is absent; same vocabulary as tokens_not_recorded_reason.

lines_not_recorded_reason.description: Why diff_added/diff_removed are absent (Core capture.lines_not_recorded_reason), e.g. no_session_commit. Null counts stay unknown, never 0.

rates.description: Per-model dated list rates Core used for an estimated cost. Absent from older Core.

source.description: Where the rate was published, e.g. the provider's pricing page.

billing_basis.description: How usage is paid for, as Core recorded it. Absent means unknown.

source.description: The gate that decided, e.g. path_policy.

base_commit.description: HEAD when the run or session STARTED. Every Core producer records it then, so it is a base, never the resulting commit.

commit.description: The resulting git commit when one is independently observed. Cloud fallback Receipts use the GitHub-observed commit.

pr_url.description: Pull request URL when the hosting provider can prove which PR contains the observed commit.

content_hash.description: Core's unkeyed content hash of the stored record. Tamper evidence, not a signature.

ended.description: Whether Core observed the session end.

hook_config_hash.description: Fingerprint of the hook configuration that captured the session. Never the configuration itself.

receipt_scope.description: turn: this Receipt covers one prompt -> completed turn; session: the whole session segment.

turn_index.description: Which turn of the session this Receipt covers; Core counts from 1.

previous_receipt_id.description: The Receipt of the session's previous turn (Core capture.resumed_from_receipt_id).

anyOf.description: Globally unique receipt identity minted by Core at record creation. Hosted idempotency key.

model.description: A model id, or a tier name when the role was only advisory.

dispatched.description: Core's routing-truth flag. False means the role model was advisory and did not run.

attempts.description: Each escalation attempt in order. Absent on records from an older Core, which kept only the last attempt.

cost_included.description: True only when Core stored every attempt's cost, so the receipt's cost_usd is the true run total including retries. Absent or null on records from an older Core, where cost_usd is the first attempt only.

own_copy_verification.description: OpenShard's own verification in the agent's isolated copy: passed | failed | unknown. Null when it did not run.

selected.description: A candidate whose implementation was chosen.

cost_per_verified_success.description: The complete run cost when the run verified, else null. Unknown is never zero.

base_sha.description: Tip of the base at check time.

behind_by.description: Commits on base not in head; null when unknown, never 0.

base_commits.description: Commits base gained since the merge-base, newest first.

subject.description: The commit subject line only. Never the body or diff.

conflicts.description: [] = checked and clean; null or absent = could not determine.

path.description: Repository-relative path of a file changed on both sides.

lines.description: 1-based line numbers in the HEAD version where the conflicting hunks start. Numbers only, never the lines.

base_author.description: Git author name of the base-side commit that last touched those lines; null when blame could not tell.

agent_type.description: The agent's own label, e.g. Explore.

parent_agent.description: `lead` (the session's main agent) or the agent_id of the subagent that launched it.

tokens_incomplete.description: true: some of its usage was unreadable, so the counts are a lower bound.

status.description: Whether the subagents' costs fit inside the Receipt's own cost; exceeds_session_total means the figures do not reconcile.

name.description: e.g. claude_code, github_actions, codespaces; null when only the kind is known.
e.g. vscode, jetbrains, iterm2, terminal, sdk, claude_desktop, claude_web.

steering.description: Proposed by Core (docs/steering-capture.md): when a person steered the agent, and derived autonomy facts. Counts, enums, times and lengths only; never prompt text or paths. null/absent: not captured.

base_sha.description: The base the change was compared with (its merge-base was used).

seal.description: Optional install seal (Core seal v2) over this exact receipt. Absent from Core before seal v2 and from unsigned Receipts.

payload.description: The in-toto Statement bytes, standard base64.

public_key.description: The raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key, standard base64.
